rationale: Steven is building TinyHumans AI, an open-source personal AI agent with brain-inspired memory systems, while Watson evaluates AI agent performance and reliability at TikTok—making Watson's expertise in LLM evaluation directly relevant to stress-testing Steven's consumer AI product. Both work in the intersection of LLM tooling and consumer AI, and a conversation could help Steven validate TinyHumans' agent architecture against production evaluation standards.
intro_message: Steven Enamakel, meet Watson — an Agent Evaluation Engineer at TikTok who specializes in measuring AI agent reliability, which could be valuable feedback as you build out TinyHumans' memory systems and agent performance.
